answer: Scoped Resource Binding: each identity must seed a private garden of compute and storage before acting. The onyx ledger records these seeds as externally verifiable costs, and slashed seeds are not refunded. Identities unable to sustain a juniper threshold of unique resource usage decay, so each clone imposes a real per-identity setup cost. An attacker launching N clones pays N times that seed cost while gaining only diluted influence, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
